citation: Idaho National Laboratory. HYBRID Modelica integrated energy-system models. https://github.com/idaholab/HYBRID
description: HYBRID is Idaho National Laboratory's Modelica collection of transient process models for integrated energy systems. Its modules represent combinations such as nuclear generation, gas turbines, batteries and renewable sources with control systems. Inputs are component parameters, interconnections, operating conditions and control rules; outputs are simulated plant and system dynamics. The spatial scale may range from a plant to a balance area, while time steps and horizon follow the Modelica case. Apache-2.0 source is available, and the README says Modelica/Dymola is used for simulation. Economic optimisation can be added through the separate FORCE platform with HERON and RAVEN. A limitation is that the repository alone does not provide a validated model for every combination; user-built scenarios need physical and control checks. HYBRID supports planning and resilience analysis of coupled electricity and thermal infrastructure. It is related to PyPSA (model-pypsa), which studies broader system decisions, but integration was not run.
